messages:
Nina: Heads-up: Harbor is asking for a short "one-pager" runbook for onboarding — they see mid-session stream pauses. want it customer-friendly, include quick-checks, a canary, and a feedback hook.

Caleb: Symptom summary?

Nina: stalls after ~10s on heavy context (>2500 tokens). disconnects rose 0.05 -> 0.12 in 7 days.

Tara: Proposed customer quick-checks: 1) run sample prefill on 5 sessions, confirm first bytes <3s; 2) enable adaptive_streaming with 12s client timeout; 3) capture 3 failed session_ids if any.

Mike: Config snippets for runbook (API + console):
API prefill:
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/prefill -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" -d '{"session_id":"harbor-01","prompts":["Recap last convo","User context..."]}'
Console copy:
route: harbor-main
adaptive_streaming: true
stream_timeout_ms: 12000
fallback_route: harbor-fallback
cache_ttl_s: 30

Caleb: Canary plan: 5% -> 15% -> 100% over 24h if stream_err_rate < 0.03. create alert for stream_err_rate > 0.03 over 10m. CI-Bot: please create.

CI-Bot: alert created: 'harbor_stream_canary_err' -> #eng-oncall threshold 0.03 / 10m.

Tara: Feedback capture: lightweight post-stream prompt (thumbs up/down + comment) tied to session_id. include event example in doc.

Nina: Rollback: toggle adaptive_streaming:false and switch to stable route. note token-cost may drop 10-30% after rollback.

Mike: I'll assemble the one-pager and post link.

Caleb: Ops will validate prefill on staging Monday.

Nina: Thanks — aim to send to Harbor by Wed.
